newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Microwave to sell radar assets.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Microwave to sell radar assets.

text.p: Cincinnati Microwave Inc said Monday it signed an asset purchase agreement under which Escort Acquisition Corp would buy its rader detector business and its real property for $10.9 million, plus certain temporary advances.
Escort is a company owned by Chicago businessman Matthews Coleman, Cincinnati Microwave said.

Cincinnati Microwave filed on February 14 for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection. It recently asked for a court order to sell the radar assets, establish auction procedures and set a hearing date on April 7 on the sale of its assets.
